text: Peace for the whole camp. While it is fed, the Hush Totem stops hostiles from spawning within **24 blocks**, for **8 Pulse** a second.

pages.title: Keeping it quiet
text: Place it in the middle of camp with generators within 8, and a **Spirit** totem within 8 as well: without its voice it stands idle (see [Camp hands](camp_hands)). It keeps a reserve of **2,400 Pulse** to bridge a quiet spell, and refills it by up to **80 Pulse** a second. Right-click it with a Pulse Cell to top it up by hand.

It stops natural spawns and spawner spawns of every hostile, the overworld's and the March's alike, including a Summoning Cradle's hostiles. It keeps **phantoms** off too: none are sent after a player standing inside the circle.
It does not remove mobs already there, it does not stop animals, and it never overrules commands or spawn eggs.
Redstone silences it at once. A comparator reads 15 while it is hushing.

pages.title: Living with it
text: Hostiles can still walk in from outside the circle, so keep the edges lit as well, or set a Ward Drum at the gate.
If you run a Summoning Cradle for hostiles, keep it more than 24 blocks from the totem, or put the totem on a lever and switch between peace and summoning.
A Spirit Lantern and a Hush Totem together make a quiet camp.
